# 2 Baruch Chapter 85 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "Know therefore that our fathers in time past took strangers from Sodom to dwell among them and received their ways."

**2** "And it came to pass that when they perished, they were not remembered after death; and there is no memory of them now."

**3** "And also know that all our ancestors in time past sinned, and they are gone into Sheol; and they have been dealt with by the judgment which they deserved."

**4** "And now we ourselves, if we obey the law of the Mighty One, will be received into that world that does not pass away."

**5** "And we will see the things that have been spoken of, and we will receive the things that have been promised."

**6** "For the Mighty One has prepared from the beginning all things for those who live after the commandments; and he has kept for them all things which will be."

**7** "And now you know that we have not done righteousness; and you know that we have not observed the law."

**8** "For behold, we are now in captivity; and we are in a strange land, and we are suffering."

**9** "But the days of exile will pass away, and the time of affliction will not endure, and the Mighty One will be our consolation."

**10** "And if you observe the law, you will not lack anything; and the Mighty One will not abandon you."

**11** "Remember again the law; and the judgment of the Mighty One will be righteous; and his mercy will be near to you."

**12** "Do not transgress; and do not forsake the covenant of the Most High; and do not depart from the law of the Holy One."

**13** "For I know that after us our children will not depart from the law; and the Mighty One will be with them."

**14** "For I know that the Mighty One is faithful; and that he will not utterly forsake his people."

**15** "Now therefore, hear the conclusion of my word, and receive it in your hearts; and write it on the tablets of your mind."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
